name: minecraft-afk-bot
description: Robust AFK bot for Minecraft servers with infinite uptime: connects to vanilla or Forge servers, wanders around, chops wood, crafts, mines iron/coal, and fights off (or flees from) mobs on its own.

scripts.test: node --check index.js && for f in modules/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done

author: Lamgerr
